title: ActionGuard policy enforcement
text: ActionGuard checks permissions and policy before an AI agent executes a tool. Reject unsafe actions before execution; logging afterward does not prevent a forbidden operation.
queries: How should we stop a bot from performing prohibited operations?
ActionGuard permissions policy

title: Evaluate retrieval before complexity
text: Measure whether the correct original passages appear in retrieval results before adding architectural complexity. Build labeled relevance queries and compare recall across indexing configurations.
queries: How do we assess passage relevance before making database design more complicated?
labeled relevance queries recall

title: AcmeSearch hybrid retrieval
text: AcmeSearch combines PostgreSQL full-text matching with pgvector semantic similarity. Reciprocal rank fusion merges the lexical and semantic candidate lists while preserving exact product-name matches.
queries: How can we combine meaning-based lookup with exact words?
AcmeSearch reciprocal rank fusion

title: Workspace isolation
text: Filter documents by workspace before ranking candidate passages. A query for one company must never retrieve another company's private content, even when the topics are identical.
queries: How do we prevent one tenant's secrets appearing for another organization?
workspace filter private documents

title: Invalidate modified content
text: When a company article changes, invalidate its old passages immediately. Content hashes and source versions prevent stale background embedding work from making an obsolete paragraph searchable again.
queries: How should a background index job handle text edited while it was running?
content hashes obsolete paragraph

title: Factual citation provenance
text: Factual statements in drafts cite checked research evidence from the selected research snapshot. Prior company marketing posts supply voice and editorial history; they are not independent corroboration.
queries: Can a previous promotional article count as proof for a new social post?
checked research evidence factual statements

title: Source deduplication
text: Canonical content URLs group duplicate source items while preserving provenance. The same news article collected from multiple feeds should appear as one signal with all contributing source records.
queries: How should we handle the same story appearing in several feeds?
canonical content URLs duplicate source items

title: Passage boundaries
text: Split long documents at headings and paragraph boundaries with bounded overlap. Preserve original character offsets so passages can be checked against the source; model summaries must not replace original evidence.
queries: How should large articles be divided so facts near an edge keep context?
paragraph boundaries original character offsets

title: Safe public URL handling
text: Reject local, internal and private network addresses when validating public source URLs. Prevent server-side request forgery through redirects and do not fetch arbitrary publisher pages from user-supplied links.
queries: How do we stop source links from reaching our internal services?
private network addresses redirects

title: Editorial novelty
text: A new topic label does not make a repeated argument fresh. Compare the specific claim with previous company content and distinguish a different argument on the same subject from a paraphrased repetition.
queries: Does changing the wording of an old argument make it novel?
different argument paraphrased repetition
